name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-inner-map-update-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: value:cloneWithType, value:fromJsonWithType, value:toString and value:toBalString.
reason: The expected panic on updating m3 depends on m2.cloneReadOnly() producing a frozen clone. cloneReadOnly is absent from both the supported lang.value functions and the langlib method-call whitelist, so essential tested behavior is outside subset 10.
test_design_notes: The asserted panic is a write to the cloned map's top-level one entry, despite the test name mentioning an inner map.
